name: Gut viral genomes assembler and binner comparison
description: A comparative benchmark analyzing short- and long-read metagenomic assemblies and binning approaches to characterize gut viral genomes across diverse datasets.
evaluation_method: composite (precision, recall, F1, completeness, contamination, N50 and other assembly/binning-specific metrics)
general_score_metric: composite (F1 / completeness / contamination reported per tool)
reputation: A domain-specific comparative study used by metagenomics researchers to assess assembler and binner performance; valuable for specialists but not a broadly standardized community benchmark.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; performance strongly dependent on sequencing technology (short vs long reads), sample complexity, and ground-truth availability; real metagenomes lack perfect ground truth so synthetic/spiked datasets may not fully reflect performance on natural samples; contamination and strain-level ambiguity are common issues.
